open_findings.reason: The Definition permits arbitrary balanced (including disconnected and empty) manifolds but uses a single open ball to define vector-field homology. On two disjoint product balls, choose v, then w by a local Hopf modification in the first ball, then z by one in the second. The pairs v,w and w,z satisfy the relation, but v,z do not: removing one ball leaves the other nonzero relative Hopf class. The empty manifold also has no witnessing ball even for reflexivity. The connected knot-exterior branch used by this assigned theorem does not meet this defect. Preserve general scope by using one ball in each connected component (with the empty-family convention), rather than silently restricting all balanced manifolds to connected ones.
